description: This file defines the UsersController class, which handles user-related HTTP requests such as user creation and login in an ASP.NET Core application. It uses MediatR to send commands for processing.

classes.name: UsersController
classes.description: Controller managing user registration and login endpoints, utilizing dependency injection for IMediator.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new user by sending a Create.Command via mediator.

methods.name: Login
methods.description: Handles POST request for user login by sending a Login.Command via mediator.
